payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the image show the background changed into a recognizable basketball court?
node.criteria: Complete only if the saved support evidence establishes both a source-to-edit background replacement and that the edited background as a whole is recognizable as a basketball-court playing area. Basketball props, a floor strip, or an isolated line without coherent court context are insufficient. Partial if the evidence establishes basketball-related background progress but does not establish a recognizable court. Absent only if the evidence establishes no requested background progress. Unknown if the source-to-edit change or court recognizability remains genuinely unresolved; do not resolve conflicting reports by privileging either support or infer visual facts absent from them.
